releaseNotes:
🚀 3.1 Update!

- New feature: Auto Click & Auto Swipe. A floating ▶ button taps or swipes your screen at the interval you choose
- Pick Auto click, Auto swipe, or Tap + swipe, then set the interval, tap position and swipe length
- Drag the button anywhere, tap ▶ to start and ■ to pause. No extra permissions
- Find it under Gaming
